## Caveats

- ACM publication formats use different page and column geometries, so this generic profile intentionally leaves physical widths unspecified.
- The target conference or journal can impose additional figure and accessibility requirements.

ResearchPlot exposes source-backed evidence and unresolved checks; it does not guarantee
editorial acceptance. Journal-specific instructions override generic publisher guidance.
